parent_negative_result: P3 Pi2-near-one ambiguity prediction not supported
scientific_scope: closed-world spatiotemporal identifiability geometry; no field calibration, no observer tuning, no physical transition claim

ontology.baseline: no deviation; no classification question is triggered
ontology.exogenous_nuisance_N: positive external process capable of mimicry, masking or attribution corruption
ontology.target_to_scene_coupling_C: target-caused local scene response; C implies T
ontology.non_exclusivity: T and N may be simultaneously true and must not be converted to an error state merely because both are supported
ontology.undetermined: inference-side state caused by information absence, essential ambiguity or model uncertainty; it is not a third physical process

process_model.target: localized entry-dwell-exit/transit over normalized target timescale
process_model.exogenous_nuisance_temporal_process: stationary mean-reverting stochastic process with correlation timescale Pi2
process_model.exogenous_nuisance_spatial_process: focal nuisance is the shared component; each reference region mixes shared and independent same-timescale components with shared weight exp(-distance/Pi5)
process_model.target_coupling: target-triggered local damped response with amplitude Pi4 confined to the focal target support; reference regions begin at one target-support width and receive no coupled response
process_model.sampling: sample spacing is 1/Pi6 in target-time units; Pi6 changes the actual number of samples rather than being a post-hoc feature

focused_collision_sweep.purpose: resolve local geometry around simultaneous temporal and spatial scale collision after coarse sweep without changing the registered prediction

pre_sweep_predictions.Q1_sampling: At fixed Pi1-Pi5, decreasing Pi6 increases information absence once the target process is undersampled.
pre_sweep_predictions.Q2_spatial: At fixed temporal coordinates, changing Pi5 changes observed spatial-coherence and structure-function signatures; the direction of final ambiguity is measured rather than assumed.
pre_sweep_predictions.Q3_collision_interaction: Among coordinates where both target and nuisance are temporally resolved and Pi3/Pi4 are weak, ambiguity is predicted to increase near Pi2=1 preferentially when Pi5 is also near 1. This is a new interaction prediction, not a rescue or rerun of V14a P3.
pre_sweep_predictions.Q4_negative_boundary: If the Pi2-by-Pi5 interaction is absent after explicit Pi6 control, the timescale-collision hypothesis is rejected more strongly.
pre_sweep_predictions.Q5_superposition: High target and high nuisance support may coexist as legitimate superposition and must not itself count as undetermined.

execution_gate.unlock_condition: generator contract tests and ordinary CI green on the exact prefreeze commit, then record commit and protocol SHA-256 before first full sweep
